5080.title: Session restoration uses the wrong request deadline
5080.rootCauseOneLine: The runtime resume path omits the existing construction deadline, so JSON-RPC uses its 30-second fallback and ignores configured construction limits.
5080.proposedFix: Forward the existing construction timeout on resume and extend the lifecycle regression to cover the default and configured deadlines.
5080.caveats: No private large session or live pi account was accessed. The same agent repeated the deterministic runtime/bridge reproduction in a second clean checkout.
